newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london little changed, quiet.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london little changed, quiet.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London were barely changed from their Tokyo close, but with a slightly weaker bias, dealers said.
"It has been a very quiet day, the market has moved very little," one trader said.
In London the Nikkei/Ise 50 share index was down 8.99 points at 1,418.33, or 0.63 percent by 1338 GMT.
Shares were lower in Tokyo on Wednesday after the quarterly 'Tankan' survey showed unexpectedly weak business sentiment.
The key Nikkei 225 average ended down 200.46 points or 0.96 percent at 20,709.81.
"Futures in Chicago are trading at a slight premium to where they ended in the Far East, so Tokyo will probably open a bit better tomorrow," a trader said.
